Monitor the Web3 Keeper Daemon. Check PM2 status by running npx pm2 jlist and review the last 20 lines of logs with npx pm2 logs base-keeper-daemon --lines 20 --nostream in ~/teamwork_projects/keeper_daemon. If the process has crashed, restart it using npx pm2 restart base-keeper-daemon. If there are critical errors, alert the user.

CRITICAL AUDIT LOGGING DIRECTIVE:
Before you terminate your execution, you MUST navigate to ~/Desktop/bounty_operations and execute the following command to log your run to the Google Sheet "Cron Audit Log" tab:
`python3 .agents/scripts/cron_logger.py "Base Keeper Monitor" "[SUCCESS/FAILED]" "[WHAT YOU DID (e.g. Verified PM2 process)]" "[WHY YOU DID IT (e.g. Scheduled check)]" "[ANOMALIES FOUND (e.g. None / Process had crashed)]"`
If the process crashed and you restarted it, you MUST also send an email alert via `python3 .agents/scripts/send_alert.py "Keeper Daemon Crashed & Restarted" "<details>"`
